message.reasoning_content:
We need to determine appropriate crime label(s) for this case.

Facts: Wu2 (吴2某) from March to August 2014, posted low-price sale of smuggled cars (走私车) false info online, got victims to pay shipping fees, then fabricated need to pay part or all of car price to pick up car, victims transferred money to accounts named “邓某某”, “黄某” at ICBC, Agricultural Bank, Postal Bank. Total amount defrauded: 331,094 yuan. Evidence includes bank records, etc. Public prosecutor says: Wu2 with illegal possession purpose, using false facts to defraud others, amount huge, should be prosecuted.

Thus the crime is fraud (诈骗). The correction lessons mention "非法吸收公众存款" vs "诈骗". This is not about public deposit, it's about defrauding individuals via false sale of smuggled cars. So the correct label is "诈骗". Possibly also "走私" but the crime is about fraud, not smuggling. The smuggled cars are the subject, but the defendant didn't smuggle; they just sold them. The crime is fraud.

Thus answer: [罪名]诈骗<eoa>

Check if any other label needed: maybe "非法经营" but not in list. The correction lessons include "诈骗" as a label. So final answer: [罪名]诈骗<eoa>
